insight: Founders Shazeer and De Freitas rejoined Google in a 2024 licensing deal while the app kept running under new leadership.
name: Character.AI
tagline: Chat with millions of user-made AI characters.
description: A consumer platform for creating and chatting with AI personas — fictional characters, helpers, and roleplay companions — across web and mobile. Hosts millions of community-built characters with voice calls and image generation on the paid tier. One of the largest conversational-AI roleplay products by usage.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from assistant to the new companion category for character/roleplay AI.

edge: Among the largest roleplay-AI products by usage, with unusually sticky daily engagement versus general chatbots.
pros: Voice calls and image gen on paid tier
cons: Founders departed to Google in 2024 deal
